translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
insan per kabhi aisa waqt aaya hai kay nahi jab woh koi qabil-e-ziker cheez nahi tha-?
hum ney insan ko aik milay julay nutfay say iss tarah peda kiya ,   kay ussay aazmayen , phir ussay aisa banaya kay woh sunta bhi hai , dekhta bhi hai .
hum ney ussay raasta dikhaya kay woh ya to shukar guzaar ho , ya nashukra ban jaye .
hum ney hi kafiron kay liye zanjeeren , galay kay toq aur bharakti hoi aag tayyar ki hai .
beyshak naik log aesay jaam say mashroobat piyen gay jiss mein kafoor ki aamezish hogi ,
yeh mashroobat aik aesay chashmay kay hon gay jo Allah kay ( naik ) bandon kay peenay kay liye makhsoos hai , woh ussay ( jahan chahen gay ) aasani say baha kerlay jayen gay .
yeh woh log hain jo apni mannaten poori kertay hain , aur uss din ka khof dil mein rakhtay hain jiss kay buray asraat her taraf phelay huye hon gay .
aur woh Allah ki mohabbat ki khatir miskeeno , yateemon aur qediyon ko khana khilatay hain ,
. ( aur unn say kehtay hain kay : )  hum to tumhen sirf Allah taalaa ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye khila rahey hain . hum tum say naa koi badla chahtay hain , aur naa koi shukriya !
hamen to apney perwerdigar ki taraf say uss din ka darr laga huwa hai jiss mein chehray buri tarah bigrey huye hon gay .
iss ka nateeja yeh hai kay Allah aesay logon  ko uss din kay buray asraat say bacha ley ga , aur unn ko shadabi aur suroor say nawazay ga ,
aur unhon ney jo sabar say kaam liya tha , uss kay badlay mein unhen jannat aur reshami libas ata farmaye ga .
woh unn baaghon mein aaram deh oonchi nishiston per takiya lagaye howe bethay hon gay , jahan naa woh dhoop ki tapish dekhen gay , aur naa karrakay ki sardi .
aur halat yeh hogi kay unn baaghon kay saye unn per jhukay huye hon gay , aur unn kay phal mukammal tor say unn kay aagay raam kerdiye jayen gay .
aur unn kay samney chaandi kay bartan aur woh piyalay gardish mein laye jayen gay jo sheeshay kay hon gay ,
sheeshay bhi chaandi kay   jinhen bharney walon ney tawazun kay sath bhara hoga .
aur wahan unn ko aisa jaam pilaya jaye ga jiss mein soonth mila huwa hoga ,
wahan kay aesay chashmay say jiss ka naam salsabeel hai .
unn kay samney ( khidmat kay liye ) aesay larkay gardish mein hon gay jo hamesha larkay hi rahen gay .   jab tum unhen dekho gay to yeh mehsoos kero gay kay woh moti hain jo bikhair diye gaye hain .
aur ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) jab tum woh jagah dekho gay to tumhen naimaton ka aik jahan aur aik bari saltanat nazar aaye gi .

unn kay oopper bareek resham ka sabz libas aur dabeez resham kay kapray hon gay , aur unhen chaandi kay kangganon say aarasta kiya jaye ga , aur unn ka perwerdigar unhen nihayat pakeezah sharab pilaye ga .
. ( aur farmaye ga kay : )  yeh hai tumhara inaam ! aur tum ney ( duniya mein ) jo mehnat ki thi uss ki poori qadar daani ki gaee hai .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney hi tum per Quran thora thora ker kay nazil kiya hai .
lehaza tum apney perwerdigar kay hukum per sabit qadam raho , aur inn logon  mein say kissi nafarman ya kafir ki baat naa maano .
aur apney perwerdigar kay naam ka subha o shaam ziker kiya kero .
aur kuch raat ko bhi uss kay aagay sajday kiya kero , aur raat kay lambay waqt mein uss ki tasbeeh kero .
yeh log to ( duniya ki ) fori cheezon say mohabbat kertay hain , aur apney aagay jo bhari din aaney wala hai , ussay nazar andaz kiye huye hain .
hum ney hi enhen peda kiya hai , aur inn kay jorr band mazboot kiye hain , aur hum jab chahen inn kay badlay inn jaisay doosray peda kerden .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh aik naseehat ki baat hai . abb jo chahye , apney perwerdigar ki taraf janey wala raasta ikhtiyar kerlay .
aur tum chahao gay nahi jab tak Allah naa chahye . aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik ,
woh jiss ko chahta hai , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerleta hai , aur yeh jo zalim log hain , inn kay liye uss ney dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .
